newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy offers up, corn steady/firm.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy offers up, corn steady/firm.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values rose in most positions on Thursday supported by slow cash movement and export demand while corn values were steady to firmer, dealers said. Soft red winter wheat values softened.
The lack of supplies in the export pipeline, slack farm sales and strong cash bids supported soybean and corn values, one dealer said.

While Thursday's Agriculture Department weekly export report showed that China bought only 55,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans and 50,000 tonnes soymeal in the week ended October 3, some exporters believed not all of the business was done.
They may have bought maybe 300,000 to 400,000 tonnes soymeal and about 100,000 tonnes of that could be U.S., one soybean broker said.

SRW wheat values were down weighed down by lack of business, another dealer said. "White wheat was off in the West Coast, spring wheat premiums were down and hard red wheat was the only wheat "that was hanging in there," he said.
